parameters.content:
## Automate image copyright checks on Google Lens into Google Sheets

No stock agency monitoring service and no per-image fee. Every week this looks up each image you list and appends one row per page carrying that exact image: the site using it, the page title, the page URL, and the dimensions of the copy they are serving.

Point it at your own photography, product shots or illustrations and the sheet becomes a usage log. Because it appends a dated snapshot, a site that appears in this week's rows and not last week's is a new use.

**Who's it for**
Photographers and illustrators checking where their work ended up, brands watching for product shots on marketplaces they never authorised, and anyone who needs a list of URLs before they can send a single email.

**How it works**
1. A schedule trigger fires once a week
2. One Set node holds the image URLs you want to watch
3. The Apify node runs an exact-match lookup for each image
4. A Code node turns each match into a row with the page and the site

**Setup**
1. Create a free Apify account and add your API token to the Apify credential
2. Connect your Google account in the Sheets node and pick a spreadsheet
3. Replace the example image URLs with links to your own images, each one publicly reachable without a login

**Good to know**
About a third of a cent per match, so an image with 30 uses costs about a cent to check.
This finds pages using your image. It does not decide who owns it or whether a use is licensed, so treat the sheet as a list of leads to review rather than a verdict.
Not every image is in the index. A brand new upload, or one behind a login, will return nothing. Test one image manually before trusting a whole portfolio to a schedule.
Actor: https://apify.com/johnvc/google-lens-api?fpr=9n7kx3&fp_sid=n8n

### 1. Schedule
Runs every Monday morning. Change the cadence, or swap in a manual trigger while you test.

### 2. Your input
The image URLs to watch, and how many matches to return for each. This is the only node you edit.

### 3. Fan out
Turns your image list into one Lens lookup each.

### 4. Look up
Runs the Google Lens API actor in exact-match mode. Add your Apify credential here.

### 5. Clean
Keeps only real match rows, so an upstream error never reaches the sheet.

### 6. Shape
One row per page using the image, with the source image kept on the row.

### 7. Deliver
Pick your spreadsheet and tab. Columns map automatically.

### Images must be publicly reachable
The lookup fetches the URL you give it, so a link behind a login, a signed URL, or a local path returns nothing. Some hosts are simply not in the index either, so a zero-row result means unknown rather than unused.

### It finds uses, not infringements
A row means a page is serving your image. It might be licensed, credited, or fair use. Read the sheet as a shortlist to review, not a list of offenders.
